sanskrit: yat te pṛṣṭiṣu daurbhāgyaṃ jaghane sphijor hitam | (…) ||
english: Whatever ill-fortune lodged in your back, placed in your haunches and buttocks — [let Apāmārga wipe that away].

sanskrit: yat ta urasi daurbhāgyaṃ pārśvayo stanayor hitam | (…) ||
english: Whatever ill-fortune in your chest, placed in your flanks and breasts — [let Apāmārga wipe that away].

sanskrit: yat te hṛdaye daurbhāgyaṃ nābhyāṃ vakṣaṇā anu | (…) ||
english: Whatever ill-fortune in your heart, along the navel and the belly — [let Apāmārga wipe that away].

sanskrit: yat te plīhni daurbhāgyaṃ yad vā yakani vṛkkayoḥ | (…) ||
english: Whatever ill-fortune in your spleen, or in the liver and the kidneys — [let Apāmārga wipe that away].

sanskrit: yat te gudāsv āntreṣu daurbhāgyam udare hitam | (…) ||
english: Whatever ill-fortune in your bowels and intestines, placed in the belly — [let Apāmārga wipe that away].

sanskrit: yat te vastau daurbhāgyaṃ vaniṣṭhau plāśāv āhitam | (…) ||
english: Whatever ill-fortune in your bladder, deposited in the vaniṣṭhau and the plāśau — [let Apāmārga wipe that away].

sanskrit: yat te bhaṃsasi daurbhāgyaṃ yad vā yāśuṣu muṣkayoḥ | (…) ||
english: Whatever ill-fortune in your pudendum, or in the seminal vesicles and testicles — [let Apāmārga wipe that away].

sanskrit: yat te śroṇyor daurbhāgyam avacālūśayor hitam | (…) ||
english: Whatever ill-fortune in your hips, placed in the avacālūśa joints — [let Apāmārga wipe that away].

sanskrit: yat te bhasadi daurbhāgyam ūrvor jānunor hitam | (…) ||
english: Whatever ill-fortune in your posterior, placed in your thighs and knees — [let Apāmārga wipe that away].

sanskrit: yat te jaṅghayor daurbhāgyaṃ sthūrayoḥ pārṣṇyor hitam | (…) ||
english: Whatever ill-fortune in your calves, placed in the shin-bones and heels — [let Apāmārga wipe that away].

sanskrit: yat te gulphayor daurbhāgyaṃ pādayor aṅgulīr anu | (…) ||
english: Whatever ill-fortune in your ankles, along the feet and toes — [let Apāmārga wipe that away].

sanskrit: (yat) te paruṣu daurbhāgyaṃ māṃse asthiṣu majjasu | (…) ||
english: Whatever ill-fortune in your joints, in your flesh, bones, and marrow — [let Apāmārga wipe that away].

sanskrit: yat te kiṃ ca daurbhāgyam aṅgeaṅge pratiṣṭhitaṃ yad vā lomasu viṣṭhitam | (…) ||
english: Whatever ill-fortune, in whatever limb it has settled, or that is lodged in the hairs — [let Apāmārga wipe that away].

sanskrit: yat te akṣeṣu daurbhāgyaṃ prahāyām adhidevane | (…) ||
english: Whatever ill-fortune in your dice-play, in the game of chance and gambling — [let Apāmārga wipe that away].

sanskrit: yat te paśuṣu daurbhāgyaṃ kṛṣyām aśaner hitam | (…) ||
english: Whatever ill-fortune in your cattle, placed in the field and in [loss through] thunderbolt — [let Apāmārga wipe that away].

sanskrit: yā te lakṣmīr brūṇahatyā- -atho yā te aputratā | (…) ||
english: That ill-luck of yours born of fetus-slaying, and likewise your sonlessness — [let Apāmārga wipe that away].

sanskrit: yat te diṣṭaṃ pitṛṣadyam atho yā te apacitā | (…) ||
english: Whatever of yours has been fated by sitting with the Fathers, and likewise your [ill] destiny unfulfilled — [let Apāmārga wipe that away].

sanskrit: yā te kā ca pāpī lakṣmīr atho yā te apaśutā | ayaṃ tad viśvabheṣajo apāmārgo 'pa lumpatu ||
english: Whatever evil fortune is yours, and likewise your lack of livestock — let this Apāmārga, the all-healer, wipe all that away.

sanskrit: kaṇṭhadaghnām ahimārttinṛṇāṃ devebhyaḥ kilbiṣaṃ yad babhūva | imās tad āpaḥ pra vahantu ripraṃ punātu mā śatadhāraṃ pavitram ||
english: Whatever guilt toward the gods has accrued to those throat-deep, to those tormented by the serpent — let these waters carry that defilement away; let the hundred-streamed purifier purify me.

sanskrit: snāhi ripraṃ śamalaṃ ca sarvaṃ kṛṣṇe cele sādayitvā pāpam | hitvāvartiṃ nirṛtiṃ mṛtyupāśān sūryaṃ jyotir abhy ehy agnim ||
english: Bathe off all defilement and impurity; having deposited sin in dark garments, forsake adversity, Nirṛti, and the snares of death — come forward to the light of Sūrya, to Agni.

sanskrit: udyanto asmān mahataḥ samudrān mucyamāno aṃhasaḥ pāpmanaś ca | punar manaḥ punar āyur na āgan mā mā dabhan paṇayo yātudhānāḥ ||
english: Rising up from the great ocean, being released from distress and from sin — may mind return to us, may life-force return to us; let not the Paṇis and Yātudhānas deceive me.

sanskrit: ava ripram anikṣmahy aśastim adhy ātmanaḥ | varca ā dhīyatāṃ mayi teja ā dhīyatāṃ mayi | prāṇāpānau mā mā hāsiṣṭaṃ sarvam āyur aśīya ||
english: We wash off the defilement, the ill-spoken word from ourselves. Let brilliance be placed in me, let radiance be placed in me; let prāṇa and apāna not forsake me — may I attain full life-span.

sanskrit: brahma bhrājad ud agād antarikṣaṃ divaṃ ca brahmāvādhūṣṭāmṛtena mṛtyum | brahmopadraṣṭā sukṛtasya sākṣād brahmāsmad apa hantu śamalaṃ tamaś ca ||
english: Brahman, blazing, has risen up into the atmosphere and heaven; Brahman has shaken off death with amṛta; Brahman, overseer, is the direct witness of good deeds — may Brahman drive away from us impurity and darkness.

sanskrit: pratīcīr āyatā stara vitatāḥ paśyāmahai | samudre apsu yā hitā- -asurāṇām ayasmayī ||
english: Westward-stretching, spread out, extended — we see them; that iron [net] of the Asuras, placed in the ocean, in the waters.

sanskrit: hariḥ suparṇo divam āruho 'rciṣā ye tvā dipsanti divam utpatantam | ava tāṃ jahi harasā jātavedo 'bibhyad ugro hy arciṣā divam ā roha sūrya ||
english: The tawny Suparṇa has climbed to heaven with his flame. O Jātavedas, those who seek to harm you as you fly up to heaven — strike them down with your blaze; fearless and mighty, mount heaven with your flame, O Sūrya.

sanskrit: ayojālā asurā māyino 'yasmayaiḥ pāśair aṅkino ye caranti | tāṃs te randhayāmi harase jātavedaḥ sahasrabhṛṣṭiḥ sapatnān pramṛṇan yāhi vajraḥ ||
english: The Asuras are iron-netted sorcerers, those who roam marked with iron fetters; I subject them to your consuming fire, O Jātavedas — go, O Vajra of a thousand edges, crushing my rivals.

sanskrit: devānām adhipā eti gharma ṛtena bhrājann amṛtaṃ vicaṣṭe | hiraṇyavarṇo nabhaso deva sūrya gharmo bhrājan divo antān pary eṣi vidyutā ||
english: The hot-drink offering, lord of the gods, proceeds, blazing with ṛta, beholding the immortal; golden-hued, divine Sūrya, the Gharma blazing with light traverses the ends of heaven with lightning.

sanskrit: vidyotante vidyuto agnijihvā hiraṇyavarṇā amṛtā apsv antaḥ samudre | rudrasya kṣipno stanayitnor vidyut tasya vaiśvānārasya hetiḥ pari ṇo vṛṇaktu ||
english: The lightnings flash, flame-tongued, golden-hued, immortal, dwelling within the waters, within the ocean; the swift lightning of Rudra amid the thunder — may the weapon of that Vaiśvānara encircle and protect us.

sanskrit: vidyutā bhrājan hṛdayaṃ yāty agnir vyāghrā apsuṣado yatra bhīmāḥ | viṣṇoḥ kramai stanayann eti rudro nudaṃ chatrūn vi mṛdho bādhamāno 'sapatnāḥ pradiśo me kṛṇotu ||
english: Blazing with lightning, Agni goes to the heart, where the terrible tigers lurk in the waters; Rudra moves with the strides of Viṣṇu, thundering, driving back enemies and battling foes — may he make my quarters free of rivals.

sanskrit: apo vasānaḥ samaity antarikṣaṃ divaṃ ca samiddho agnir divyas tapodhāḥ | vaiśvānaraḥ śamayā śītarūre apāṃ suparṇo diva eti pṛṣṭhe ||
english: Clothed in the waters, he comes together with the atmosphere and with heaven; the kindled, celestial, heat-bearing Agni — Vaiśvānara, O cool-formed one, bring calm; the eagle of the waters goes along the back of the sky.

sanskrit: vaiśvānaraḥ samudraṃ pary eti śukro gharmo bhrājan tejasā rocamāṇaḥ | nudaṃ chatrūn pradahan me sapatnān ādityo dyām adhyarukṣad vipaścit ||
english: Vaiśvānara traverses the ocean, bright, the Gharma blazing, shining with splendor; driving away enemies, burning my rivals, the wise Āditya has mounted the sky.
